$comment: Section library for the page builder (02 Provider Studio.dc.html, `libs`). page_kind is derived from merchants.type: provider→business_page, seller→store, kitchen→menu_page, both→business_page (union of provider+seller sections). `required` sections are always enabled. `default_order` is the recommended order and what 'Reset' restores. The four texts per section are shown verbatim in the builder's detail panel.

menu_page.title: Your menu page.
menu_page.save_cta: Save page and build the menu

hero.name: Header & verified badges
hero.desc: Logo, name, tagline, tier and the trust badges Northline verified.
hero.shows: Your logo on your brand colour, business name, tagline, tier badge, and up to three verified facts (licence, insurance, rating).
hero.when_on: Customers see who you are and what Northline checked before they scroll.
hero.when_off: Cannot be turned off — every Northline page opens with a verified header.
hero.source: Business step + verification results. Badges update automatically when a document is re-verified.

cta.name: Book / order button
cta.desc: The sticky action at the bottom of the page.
cta.shows: A single primary button that follows the customer as they scroll.
cta.when_on: Booking or ordering is one tap from anywhere on the page.
cta.when_off: Cannot be turned off — the page exists to take bookings and orders. You can change the label.
cta.source: Label options; the action is decided by your listings (instant book, quote, or order).

about.name: About
about.desc: Your story, team and what to expect.
about.shows: The description from the Business step, years operating, team size, languages served (kitchens: cuisines and dietary guarantees).
about.when_off: Customers go straight from header to listings. Your description still shows in search results.

services.name: Services & prices
services.desc: Bookable services with price, duration and instant/quote.
services.shows: Every approved service listing, price (or 'from' / quote), duration, and whether it's instant-book.
services.when_on: Customers compare and book a specific service directly.
services.when_off: Only the Book button remains; customers pick a service inside the booking flow instead. Not recommended.

reviews.name: Reviews & reliability
reviews.desc: Verified reviews and your on-time record.
reviews.shows: Star average, count, on-time percentage, and the three most recent verified reviews.
reviews.when_on: Shows social proof once you have reviews; before that 'New on Northline — verified'.
reviews.when_off: Hidden from the page. Rating still appears in search results and on the header badge.
reviews.source: trust.reviews — generated from completed transactions only; not editable by the merchant.

area.name: Service area map
area.desc: Where you travel and any travel fee.
area.shows: A map of your service zones with travel-fee bands.
area.when_on: Customers outside your area learn before booking; fewer cancelled jobs.
area.when_off: Customers only find out when they enter their address in the booking flow.

gallery.name: Work photos
gallery.shows: Up to 12 photos; completion photos can be promoted after customer approval.
gallery.when_on: Shows the quality of your work.
gallery.when_off: No photo section. Photos still attach to individual services.
gallery.source: media ids chosen in Studio → Business page.

faq.name: FAQ
faq.desc: Answers to what customers ask before booking.
faq.shows: Up to 8 question/answer pairs; Northline suggests the top questions for your category.
faq.when_on: Fewer pre-booking messages; answers also appear in search.

featured.name: Featured products
featured.desc: Up to 6 products you choose to lead with.
featured.shows: A hand-picked row of products with photo and price.
featured.when_on: You control what a first-time visitor sees first.

catalogue.name: All products
catalogue.desc: Your full catalogue with departments and search.
catalogue.shows: Every approved product, grouped by department, with stock and delivery cut-off.
catalogue.when_on: Customers browse and add to basket directly.
catalogue.when_off: Only Featured and the Order button remain — not recommended above ~12 products.

delivery.name: Delivery & pickup
delivery.shows: Same-day cut-off, pooled-run zones, pickup address and hours.
delivery.when_on: Customers know when their order arrives before they add to basket.
delivery.when_off: Delivery details only appear at checkout.

policies.name: Returns & allergens
policies.desc: Your return policy and allergen statement.
policies.shows: Return window, conditions, and allergen/cross-contact notes for food items.
policies.when_on: Fewer disputes; required text always available.
policies.when_off: Policies still appear at checkout and on each product (required by Business Terms B9) — this only hides the summary section.

menu.name: Menu
menu.shows: Full menu grouped by section, with photos, prices, modifier groups and allergen declarations.
menu.when_on: Customers order directly. Required for online ordering.
menu.when_off: Not recommended — the Order button opens an empty basket. Use 'pause ordering' in Live orders instead.

hours.name: Hours & prep time
hours.desc: When you're open and current wait.
hours.shows: Ordering hours, holiday hours, live prep time, accepting-orders flag.
hours.when_on: Customers see 'closed · opens 11:00' instead of ordering into a closed kitchen.
hours.when_off: Hours only appear in the ordering flow. Prep time still shows at checkout.
hours.source: food.kitchen_settings; live prep time from KDS.

fulfil.name: Delivery, pickup & catering
fulfil.desc: How customers can get your food.
fulfil.shows: Hot courier zones, pickup, scheduled orders, catering quotes.
fulfil.when_on: Customers pick a fulfilment before they build a basket.
fulfil.when_off: Fulfilment options only appear at checkout.

permit.name: Permit & inspection
permit.desc: Your AHS permit and last inspection, public.
permit.shows: AHS permit number and status, date of last Northline kitchen visit.
permit.when_on: Transparency customers value — already public record.
permit.when_off: Hidden from your page. Permit status still appears as a header badge and in search.
